note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4 ('A BGP speaker MAY advertise the Graceful Restart Capability for an address family to its peer if it has the ability to preserve its forwarding state for the address family when BGP restarts') after moving code-64 parameters into graceful-restart > short-lived. parseGRCapValue (gr_capability.go) emits '0000' when short-lived is absent, and when short-lived is present lists carried session families (or short-lived > family subset) gated by family.LookupFamily and nlrisplit.Supported(fam) with F-bit clear at config time (restartFlagsFor sets F on restart). All 4 tagged tests drive the full production config chain (LoadConfig -> ToPluginMap -> ExtractConfigSubtree -> refuseUncarriedGRFamilies -> extractGRCapabilities): positives TestRFC4724GRCapabilityListsTheFamiliesOfTheSession ('012c0001010000020100') and TestRFC4724GRCapabilityKeepsEveryFamilyTheRIBStores ('00780001850000010100', empty warnings); negatives TestRFC4724GRCapabilityClaimsNoFamilyItDoesNotCarry ('007800020100', no uncarried ipv4 tuple, F=0) and TestRFC4724GRCapabilityOmitsAFamilyNoRIBStores (runtime ipv4/rib-less SAFI 241 with !nlrisplit.Supported omitted with Warn naming peer and family, yielding '007800010100' for session list and '0078' for configured list naming only it). All 4 units carry current parseGRCapValue revert records (producer-sha a3291e8e472c81e7) in rfc/discrimination/rfc4724/RFC4724-4-4.json.
